mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% signals aggressive monetary accommodation, compressing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate prolonged low-cost capital.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% indicates severe labor market distress, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors price in prolonged economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 9.5 occurs in 10 consecutive months but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in >50% of those months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below their 12-month moving averages signal a broad-based demand collapse, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as markets anticipate aggressive fiscal stimulus.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both below 12mo_MA for 10 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >60% of those months.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) triggers expectations of monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as equity valuations contract under rising discount rates.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3.0 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in >50% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as corporate earnings prospects deteriorate under reduced manufacturing output.
failure_condition: INDPRO declines for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >50% of those months.

mechanism_narrative: Sharp monthly payroll declines exceeding 500,000 persons (PAYEMS < -500) signal acute labor market deterioration, but trigger positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days as investors anticipate aggressive monetary policy response.
failure_condition: PAYEMS monthly_change < -500 occurs in 5 consecutive months but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in >60% of those months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous quarterly GDP contraction (GDPC1 < 0) and monthly housing starts decline (HOUST < 0) signal deepening recession, triggering positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as policymakers implement stimulus measures.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline for 3 consecutive periods but S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in >60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 9.0%) in a sustained recession regime causes negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as investors price in extended economic weakness and reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 9.0 for 4 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >50% of those months.
